pages.text: $(thing)Wooden Buckets$() are an early game fluid container. They can contain $(cfg:woodenBucketCapacity) of fluid. They can pick up any kind of fluid that is used for recipes, such as those in a $(l:food/pot)Pot$() or $(l:crafting/barrels)Barrel$(). However, wooden buckets cannot place source blocks. Dumping its fluid on the ground results in a small amount of fluid that quickly disappears.
